text:
Based on the provided abstract, the systematic review categorized identified contextual determinants into organizational, community, public policy, or macro-environmental levels. It found evidence of positive associations between mental health care utilization and ten specific contextual determinants across these levels (e.g., access to school-based health centers, collaboration between organizations, urban residence, high accessibility, socio-economic status, mental health parity laws, screening programs, insurance coverage extensions). Therefore, the evidence directly supports this hypothesis.

VERDICT: ACCEPT
